display_long_description:
# **🛡️ DEFEND YOUR HOME IN HOUSE DEFENDER**

Welcome to **House Defender**, an auto-adaptive Mixed Reality game that turns your whole room into a free-roam playspace. Defend your walls from incoming monsters, walk freely around your space, take cover behind your furniture, and protect your home! Invite your friends to join in co-located or remote multiplayer - together, you are the last line of defense until dawn brings reinforcements.

[media]
###
## **🔮 TRANSFORM YOUR SURROUNDINGS INTO A PLAYSPACE**

House Defender scans your room the moment you start. The game builds itself around your real walls and furniture, so no two homes play the same.

[media]

Then your surroundings morph into the center of an enchanted, mystical forest. A wooden fence traces your real walls and marks the boundary you have to defend. Every wall and every object becomes part of your adventure.

[media]
###
## **🌐 Multiplayer game**

- **Co-Located Fun**: Defend your own room against monsters together with 3 friends in the same physical space.
- **Remote Fun**: Virtually connect physical rooms and team up against monsters in the village square.
- **PvP Mode**: Prefer competition over cooperation? Take cover behind your furniture and battle each other in a fully virtual world, co-located or remotely.
###

**Key Features:**

- 🏠 **Room Adaptation and Transformation**
- 👥 **Multiplayer**
- 👾 **Updated Scenes, Power-Ups & Monsters**
- 🏹 **PvP and PvE Options**
###

**More from 2Sync:** 

-  Mixed Snow Worlds
-  The Last Galaxy
-  Elven Arrows

Find more: **games.2Sync.io**
